Focus

Give one person your full attention.

Focus is a protected window for two people who want to explore seriously, without new faces pulling their attention away. It begins only when both people agree.

See how Focus works ↓

Inside this chapter

Less noise.
More honest attention.

Focus creates a clear, mutual pause in discovery. It protects attention without claiming a relationship state that two people have not chosen yet.

FOCUSTwo people
One clear window
01

Mutual

Mutual or it does not exist

One person can ask to Focus. Nothing changes until the other independently accepts. There are no silent lock-ins and no pressure traps dressed as romance.

02

Time-bound

A clear window of time

Choose 14, 30, or 60 days. During that window, new introductions pause for both people so the connection has room to breathe without the noise of more options.

03

Protected

Enforced in the product

Focus is not a soft status badge. Eligibility for new introductions and likes pauses for both accounts—the calm of commitment in progress without pretending exclusivity already exists.

04

Respectful

Decide with the
dignity

Extend Focus, step into Together, return to discovery, or close with care. Each person chooses privately, and either person can end Focus at any time. The decision stays clear to both people.

What Focus protects

Attention without pressure.
Commitment without pretending.

Mutual entry

Nothing changes until both people choose Focus independently.

Private decisions

Requests, extensions, and endings are handled with dignity.

A clear next step

Continue into Together or return to discovery when it feels right.
